meaning: is / am / are (copula) · polite です · plain だ
gist: Noun + です (polite) or だ (plain) equates or identifies: X is Y. Default classroom register is です; だ is casual among friends or in plain-form writing. Soften or emphasize with よ: ですよ / だよ.

formation.note: です and だ are the same copula at different registers — never stack them (×学生だです). Topic は comes in the next lesson; for now practice Noun + です/だ alone.

explanation: です / だ is the Japanese copula: it links a noun to what that noun is. 学生です means "(I/it) am/is a student." Use です as the default polite form with teachers, strangers, and in class. Use だ with close friends or when the surrounding sentence is in plain form. Adding よ (ですよ / だよ) softens an assertion or presents the info as news for the listener. Do not combine だ and です in one ending.

senses.label: Identifying / equating
senses.body: States what something or someone is.
senses.example_en: (I) am a student. / It is a student.

senses.label: Casual identification
senses.body: Same meaning with plain だ among friends.

senses.label: Soft assertion (よ)
senses.body: ですよ / だよ presents the fact as useful news or gentle emphasis.

register_context: Default polite: です / ですよ (classroom, strangers, service). Plain/casual: だ / だよ (friends, diary, plain clauses). Never mix: ×学生だです. Negative forms (じゃないです / ではありません) are a later lesson.

mistakes.why: だ and です are the same copula. Pick one register — never stack them (×だです).
Same double-copula error in reverse order. End with です or だ, not both.
The noun comes first; the copula attaches after it.
で alone is not the polite copula ending. Use です (or casual だ).

contrasts.label: です vs だ (register)
contrasts.summary: Same "is" meaning; です is polite default, だ is plain/casual. Choose by situation, not by different grammar jobs.

contrasts.label: です vs じゃないです
contrasts.summary: Positive copula ("is") vs negative ("is not"). The ja-nai lesson covers じゃないです / ではありません.
contrasts.ex_b_ruby: [学生|がくせい]じゃないです。

contrasts.label: Bare copula vs with topic は
contrasts.summary: Bare 学生です leaves the topic to context; 私は学生です names who you mean.
contrasts.ex_a_en: (I) am a student. (topic left to context)
contrasts.ex_b_ruby: [私|わたし]は[学生|がくせい]です。
contrasts.ex_b_en: As for me, I am a student.

examples.ruby: [会社員|かいしゃいん]ですよ。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.ruby: あ、[学生|がくせい]ですよ。[先生|せんせい]です。
dialogue.english: Oh, you're a student. I'm a teacher.

checks.why: Polite copula is です. ×だです stacks two endings; ×で is incomplete.

checks.prompt: 先生（　）。 (talking to a close friend)
checks.why: Casual register → plain だ. Never combine だ and です.

checks.prompt: Which ending is the polite default for "(I) am a doctor"?
checks.why: Classroom/polite default is です. だ is casual; だです is ungrammatical.
